clauses.section_heading: Visit on the same day as a minor procedure
clauses.text: An evaluation and management visit billed on the same day as a minor procedure by the same provider is paid only when modifier 25 is appended to the visit code and the record documents a significant, separately identifiable evaluation.

clauses.section_heading: What makes the evaluation separately identifiable
clauses.text: The evaluation is separately identifiable when the record shows work beyond the assessment that is a routine part of the procedure: for example, evaluation of a different problem, or of a new problem that required a history, an examination and a treatment decision before the procedure was chosen. A different diagnosis is not required.

clauses.section_heading: When modifier 25 must not be added
clauses.text: Modifier 25 must not be added when the visit consisted only of the decision to perform a procedure that had already been planned, or of the usual care before and after the procedure. In that case the visit is included in the payment for the procedure, and the denial of the visit line is correct.
A procedure performed on one of a pair of joints or limbs must carry modifier RT or LT. A claim line with no side modifier, or with a side that the record contradicts, is denied with reason code 4.

A line denied under clause TESS-MOD-2.1 may be corrected and resubmitted when the record for the date of service states the side treated. If that record does not state the side, the provider must obtain an addendum from the treating clinician before resubmitting. The side must not be inferred from other visits.

clauses.section_heading: Distinct procedures on the same day
clauses.text: Modifier 59 identifies a procedure that is distinct from another procedure performed on the same day. It is accepted only when the record documents a separate anatomical site, a separate session or a separate lesion.
A corrected claim under this policy must be submitted as a replacement of the original claim and must be received within 90 days of the remittance date of the denial.
